region: UK/IE (commercial in US, EU, Canada, etc.)

website.note: Amarin is commercial-stage; no active development pipeline page

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Amarin is a commercial-stage pharmaceutical company focused on commercializing VASCEPA / VAZKEPA (icosapent ethyl) for cardiovascular risk reduction and severe hypertriglyceridemia. No active company-sponsored Phase 1/2/3 development trials per ctgov (only completed REDUCE-IT, MARINE, ANCHOR, TREND-HD, PREPARE-IT registrational/post-marketing studies) or 10-K. The only active trial (NCT03428477 EPA for Metastasis Trial 2 / seAFOod) is investigator-led colorectal liver-metastasis study sponsored by Mark Hull (Univ of Leeds), not Amarin-developed; classified as partner/collaborator-supplied drug.

commercial_product.name: VASCEPA / VAZKEPA (icosapent ethyl)
indications: Cardiovascular risk reduction in high-risk statin-treated patients (REDUCE-IT indication)

excluded_legacy_terminated: NCT00146211 TREND-HD Huntington (completed; legacy Amarin Neuroscience)
excluded_partner_owned: NCT03428477 EPA for Metastasis Trial 2 (seAFOod 2) — investigator-led Phase 3 colon cancer liver metastases, sponsored by Mark Hull (University of Leeds) with Amarin drug supply only
